reviews.text: I should have made this criticism years and years ago, but it's never too late. My experience with this veterinarian was extremely negative and left very serious consequences for my dog. Dr. Cristina Ciruca, at the end of everything, said she didn't know what happened because she had never experienced blindness in an animal before, and there was no way to restore his sight. The doctor said, "I'm very sorry, but he's blind now."

I want to express my enormous gratitude to the entire clinic team, especially Dr. Rodolfo, for the excellent service and professionalism. My cat was treated with great affection, attention, and care, and from the very first moment, we felt she was in good hands.
She was diagnosed with kidney disease, a situation that naturally worried us, but Dr. Rodolfo demonstrated enormous competence, sensitivity, and willingness to explain everything to us in a clear and reassuring way.
It is very comforting to find professionals who care for our animals with so much affection and dedication. I recommend this clinic without any hesitation and thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for all the care and attention you gave us and our kitten. 🐾❤️

I met Dr. Cristina in 2021 through a friend, and she was an angel in our lives. I had a bull terrier with recurring ulcers due to lack of proper treatment, and after 20 days under her care, he was excellent. Then, in 2022, it was my dog's turn, and in 2023, it was my dog's turn again. Aside from those situations, I never had any more problems thanks to the excellent service she provided. The doctor even gave me her personal number for any eventuality. On the 23rd, I asked for help because my dog ​​had developed a superficial ulcer, and even after so many years, the doctor extended a helping hand, even though she was on vacation. Unfortunately, our dog passed away, and it wasn't possible for her team to see him again. I would like to thank everyone who helped improve the quality of life of my animals, especially Andrada, who was always very helpful, and Dr. Cristina, this spectacular human being.

I read some less pleasant comments about a lack of price transparency and the like... Here goes... My Sol is one year old and has a better medical history than mine. It was my humble and kind local vet who recommended this place. It's true that I felt intimidated by the luxury; I thought I wouldn't be able to afford it. However, they were transparent from the first phone call, and were super kind even when they were delayed because they had to attend to a very urgent emergency before Sol. But above all, I've never felt so much empathy, not even in the human healthcare I've used. I was surprised because I'm usually the one offering hugs and comfort. Note: Sol's story isn't over yet, but I believe she's in the best possible hands. Gratitude to Dr. Ana Marques from Vet Belas for the recommendation, and to Dr. Catarina and Dr. Cristina from Lisbon Vet Specialist for their care, attention, affection, and professionalism.

Terrible experience, I paid €422 and if I had done what Dr. Rodolfo Leal said, my dog ​​would have been hospitalized. It was exactly the opposite of what he prescribed: omoprazole and fortiflora plus. I traveled to Madrid specifically for this, had a microbiota analysis done, and discovered what she had, which I had already expressed suspicion to the doctor who denied it was possible. It was reflux according to him.
In the analyses, he simply transcribes what is written by the laboratory, lacking critical thinking and analysis, therefore he made a wrong report without just cause. He refused to do an abdominal ultrasound (prescribe) when the reason for the consultation was abdominal discomfort, borborygmi, and recurrent colic. He referred us to colleagues in reproduction. He does a poor anamnesis and the diagnosis is even worse. He had the audacity to deny that IBS exists in dogs. But where did this doctorate come from? And/or diplomas? It's often said that dogs reflect their owners...you can see it in your dog's animosity. They try to push their own dog food even if it's not the right kind and doesn't have the correct kibble size for the breed. A disgrace. A place run by the arrogance of money.
Excellent clinic, veterinarian and receptionist incredibly friendly, polite and professional. Donatella and I appreciate all the care.
Veterinary ophthalmologists and cardiologists. Excellent service from the beginning to the end of the consultation.

I really appreciated the professionalism and friendliness. Dr. Cristina Seruca explained everything very well.
Very good facilities.
Fantastic professional staff and doctors. They treat your animal with respect and knowledge

We loved the service and Dr. Cristina Seruca was super dedicated and professional.
It was our veterinarian who recommended them after taking a closer look at our Becky's eyes.

We took our dog Noa for a cardiology consultation for a second opinion for the first time and were very well attended to, both at reception and by Dr. Nuno Pereira. Unfortunately, Noa passed away the following day due to her heart condition, and we had to return to return the medical device that had been implanted the previous day. Again, we were treated with great respect, with everyone showing consideration and empathy for the situation. Despite our short experience at Lisbon Vet Specialists, we were very satisfied. Thank you.

An excellent experience at Lisbon Vet Specialists with our Poppy. A place that so well combines technical expertise with a human and caring side. We felt supported and at ease throughout the visit. A special thank you to the whole team and especially to Dr. Catarina Marques for her dedication and care for us and our little girl. Thank you very much. We highly recommend them. 💗
My Ginja had diabetic cataract surgery at Lisbonvet. The entire team is wonderful, extremely competent and caring.

5 stars is not enough for this team!
I was desperate when I arrived at the clinic and met Dr. Rodolfo Leal, seeking to understand what was happening with my Liev, who had undergone 3 blood transfusions due to severe anemia. Euthanasia had already been suggested at another hospital because they “had never seen a case like this,” and because he “wasn’t responding to treatment” (which was poorly prescribed).
Liev gained a few months of quality life thanks to Dr. Rodolfo, and we finally obtained the correct diagnosis and treatment, as far as possible. The professionalism of the doctor and the team, the depth of the investigation, and the evident concern of everyone for the patient's well-being were the support and clarity needed to get through the painful loss of our little one. I don't remember all the names, but I can't fail to thank them specifically:
- The empathy they showed for our family. The call after the incident and the little letter were very well received ❤️
- The effort of the receptionists to schedule appointments and exams urgently, from the first contact and throughout the treatment, as the situation demanded.
- To nurse Alexandra Sousa, who was always in contact with us.
- To the doctor who performed Liev's last ultrasound urgently, outside of regular hours.
- To the ophthalmologist who, without knowing us, examined Liev in the clinic corridor on the day of the ultrasound and identified the need to take him to the hospital. Being hospitalized at the right time allowed for pain management, reducing his suffering.
- To everyone who assisted with the tests with care and patience.
- To everyone who ensured efficient communication between the clinic and the hospital. When we arrived at the emergency room, they were already waiting for us with all the tests in hand.

Thank you so much!
I wish all animals were lucky enough to find professionals like you.
